highlights: # Anthropic revenue surges 45% to nearly $17B in third quarter as AI giant gears up for IPO. Anthropic’s third-quarter revenue rose 45% to $16.8 billion from the previous quarter, according to an investor who attended a pre-IPO meeting with Anthropic leadership in San Francisco on Wednesday. Revenue in the first quarter was $4.7 billion, and $11.6 billion in the second quarter, according to the person who attended the investor day meant to familiarize prospective Anthropic investors before its highly anticipated IPO. The IPO is expected to precede a public listing by rival OpenAI, making Anthropic an early test of investor appetite for heavily unprofitable AI developers pursuing massive scale. Founded by former OpenAI executives, Anthropic has emerged as one of the leading generative AI developers with its Claude family of models. Anthropic has also sought to distinguish itself through its focus on AI safety, warning of the dangers posed by increasingly capable systems even as it competes in the race to develop and commercialize more powerful models.

highlights: Anthropic told investors it brought in $16.8 billion in revenue during the third quarter, Business Insider has learned. The company behind Claude said Wednesday that it achieved profitability on an adjusted basis last quarter. Investors view Anthropic's revenue as a proxy for the company's competition with OpenAI, and for the strength of an early AI market that has boosted stocks by trillions of dollars in value. It's unclear if the new revenue tally counts gross or net revenue, or how Anthropic arrived at its definition of profitability. The Wall Street Journal previously reported that Anthropic brought in $4.8 billion in revenue in the first quarter, then more than doubled it to around $11.6 billion in the second quarter. Since Anthropic is still private, these glimpses at revenue are a crucial stand-in for investors considering the coming IPO and AI's impact on other stocks. A torrent of state-of-the-art AI models and strong adoption of the AI coding tool Claude Code have propelled Anthropic's fortunes, making it one of the fastest-growing companies in history.
